status: Rejected for promotion; baseline controller and Transporter weights retained

candidates.decision: Rejected: isolated retention improved without an aggregate family regression, but matched oracle tower completion regressed.
Rejected before tower screening: a one-millimetre geometry-reference error regressed cube and cuboid retention.
Rejected: best isolated retention result, but matched oracle tower completion remained below baseline and the absolute retention gate was not met.

implementation.policy_geometry: Height and jaw width are estimated from the same RGB-D component used for the Transporter pick; no simulator object pose is passed to policy inference.
implementation.oracle_geometry: The diagnostic and oracle use known manifest geometry to isolate manipulation from perception.
implementation.wide_tall_rule: For estimated height >= 50 mm and width >= 48 mm, target vertical centre and increase closing force from 2 N up to a bounded 3 N; otherwise preserve baseline-equivalent depth and 2 N force.

limitations: No aggregate object family regressed, but medium cubes and medium cylinders had fewer strict-retention successes than the historical baseline matrix.
The five-scene oracle tower screen is a paired development check, not a held-out reliability estimate.
The size-aware profiles were not evaluated with Transporter policy inference because none passed the controller promotion screen.
next_target: Improve continuous retention and placement settling without changing ordinary-object grasp geometry; repeat the frozen matrix and matched tower screen before retraining.
